author: /root/knowledge_skill_owner
adversarial_method: Independent source and diff inspection plus explicit counterexample walkthroughs; not a live adoption execution or an automated behavioral test.

scenarios.reasoning: Existing empty index is preserved. Skill requires an explicit no-applicable-prior statement, not an invented prior; append only after completed independently reviewed adoption conclusion.
Prior IDs/dates/scope/status remain visible and current evidence must be rechecked. Supersedes links from new entry to old without rewriting old entry.
Canonical URL match alone is insufficient; scope/project_id/use/version/applicability checked and historical decision is explicitly not authority. Unrelated scope cannot be superseded.
Canonical upstream repository/project URL and verified aliases required; similar name is insufficient.
Stable per-task target ID, re-read index, identical entry no duplicate, conflicting entry reconcile without overwrite. Existing entries preserved.

Cannot infer empty history or current validity on read failure. Public URLs or accessible sanitized report references required; credentials/internal hosts/IPs/private endpoint URLs excluded from statements and sources.

Six versus three calendar months is a stated local default, zone preserved and destination day clamped. Example 2026-08-31 plus6 months reaches2027-02-28;2023-08-31 plus6 reaches2024-02-29. Security/license/support/releases/requirements can trigger earlier review; no scheduler claim.
No live write until conclusion independently reviewed; report-only fictional example clearly labelled and actual index remains byte-identical to HEAD.

checks.independent_execution: Candidate and all7 hashes verified; index equals HEAD; schema/test unchanged; only generated native-map runtime path changed; actual selection equals receipt and log hash matches.
checks.owner_evidence_inspected: Required impact-document-integrity suite4/4 OK,1.812s unittest,6.887s invocation; single invocation with no retries or full fallback. sync/doctor success records inspected.
checks.version_review: oss-research1.2.0->1.3.0 registry/module pin and generated skill aligned; oss-rnd0.3.0->0.4.0 plus exact index path declaration only.
checks.conciseness: Skill remains64 lines with ordered workflow, field mapping, date rule and safety constraints; directly actionable without a new runtime or schema.
checks.artifact_review: Korean change report accurately labels fictional example, existing-field map, local default rationale, suite selection and optional validator limitation.

limitations: Optional quick_validate could not start due missing PyYAML in both available interpreters, not counted as passing.
Procedure is instruction-level; no claim of atomic concurrent database writes, automatic reminders, host permissions or runtime enforcement.
No real adoption decision or live index append exercised because this task changes the workflow only.
Local identity and execution evidence are cooperating declarations, not authenticated trusted-runner attestation.
governance_conditions: Exact requested knowledge path only; manifest adds no OS access.
Existing authorization, ownership, independent review and submission gates remain applicable.
Past reports/snapshots and live index unchanged; future decisions use current workflow.
pending_authorization: None beyond standing bounded publication authorization.
re_review_triggers: Changed candidate, substantive report/evidence, applicable selection, result content, or publication scope.
